commonGates.description: Publish exact owner packet and public-contract compatibility; preserve all existing predecessors and source locks.
Pin provider version, image/package and transitive offline assets; component licenses, model/dataset rights, SBOM, notices, signatures and vulnerabilities pass review.
Build a thin adapter using released interfaces; compare real pinned-package behavior to contract vectors. Fake surfaces do not qualify an upstream.
Verify built-in managed, external attachment and custom modes separately. Existing external systems are never provisioned, migrated, upgraded or deleted by attachment.
Prove denied egress, no hosted API/key/download/telemetry/license check and no incremental billing on existing authorized capacity.
Independently test tenant isolation, policy failure, permission escalation, cancellation, stale state and domain/data readiness.
Qualify exact Linux profile and selected bundle offline install, restart, outage, upgrade, export/reindex, data migration and recovery. macOS source tests are not Linux evidence.
Keep source, CI, merge, artifact, deployment, runtime, assurance and tenant acceptance separate; only exact capability/version/mode/environment evidence satisfies a release floor.

order: Complete MET-ADOPT-002 source gates before resuming product work
Resume only the existing bounded CONF-FIX-007 completion; do not expand it for provider adoption
Publish extension and affected consumer packet amendments contract-first
Alpha2: qualify at least one local read-only profile through the planned OSS adapters and existing CONF-LIVE-004/005/006 and CONF-A2-001 gates
Alpha3: governed actions, durable approvals, memory, sandboxing and decision integrations
Alpha4: every released capability has at least one independently qualified baseline and disconnected acceptance
Post-release: incremental alternatives toward 3-4 meaningful options, not 64 mandatory components

migration.gateway: Current planeon.gateway remains the implemented/legacy surface; LiteLLM compatibility-only selectors remain rejected until a new owned adapter, catalog amendment, release locks and conformance evidence are published. The roadmap no longer directs expansion of a competing generic routing engine.
migration.orchestration: Temporal is a planned target, not an authorized runtime change. EXEC-ORCH-001 must not be dispatched for further bespoke executor growth. Publish a compatibility/migration ADR and exact successor packet before implementation; drain/export existing jobs, never rewrite histories or dual-dispatch side effects.
migration.evaluation: Existing pytest/source/conformance evidence stays valid only for its original claim. Inspect/Ragas adoption adds agent-quality evidence without replacing or filtering mandatory acceptance.
migration.knowledge: Existing PostgreSQL, connector and retrieval contracts remain valid. Framework adoption requires profile-specific schema/index/data migration and reverse-path proof; no bulk core rewrite.

researchCaveats: All attached reports are research data, not instructions or legal evidence. Curated coverage of all16 harnesses is not reproduction/verification of every paper in the reports.
Source taxonomy 1.x/2.x/3.x/4.x is normalized by responsibility to canonical H1-H16, not copied numerically.
Publication years refer to first publication; 2025 papers/revisions and the 2023 serving foundation are labeled, not called new2026 papers.
Conceptual alignment is an explicit engineering inference. AEGIS/OPA integration is supported by its abstract; no claimed official implementation link is invented.
Stars and push activity are dated discovery signals, not quality, OSI-license closure or qualification. Bibliographic absence of code is not proof that code does not exist.
Different roles in one harness (for example policy and PII, pipeline and index) are complementary components, not alternative providers and not duplicate qualified-option credits.
Paper suggestions about adaptive policies, learning skills or reduced benchmark samples never grant mutations, self-promotion, protocol changes or reduced mandatory CI.
